title: High Incidence of Anxiety, Depression and Other Mental Disorders Among People Exposed to Second-hand Smoke
what_it_is: High Incidence of Anxiety, Depression and Other Mental Disorders Among People Exposed to Second-hand Smoke

sections.label: Tobacco control policy review
sections.summary: MOH reviews tobacco control evidence and enhances efforts through education, cessation services, legislation and taxation, while NEA seeks solutions to address second-hand smoke harms.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: MOH regularly reviews the evidence surrounding tobacco control policy and is continually enhancing its efforts to further reduce the prevalence of smoking in Singapore, through public education, provision of smoking cessation services, legislation and taxation.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: As previously explained in this House, NEA is constantly looking out for reasonable and practical solutions to further strengthen our efforts to address the harms of second-hand tobacco smoke.

sections.label: Extended smoking prohibited areas
sections.summary: From 1 October 2022 smoking prohibited areas were extended to additional gardens, parks, ABC water sites and 10 recreational beaches, bringing the total to some 50,000 places.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: For instance, this month, 1 October 2022, we have further extended the smoking prohibited areas to additional public gardens and parks, as well as ABC water sites and 10 recreational beaches, including that in Sentosa.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Which means that as of now, some 50,000 places, they are banned – where smoking is prohibited.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Both MOH, HPB, NEA and the various stakeholders, we will consistently look at the evidence as well as the solutions available and will not hesitate to adjust or review this where appropriate.

sections.label: Second-hand smoke health concerns
sections.summary: The speaker says they are concerned about harmful effects of second-hand tobacco smoke, which increases cancer risk, and has reiterated answers on smoke in homes.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Again, as I have said, we are concerned about the harmful effects of second-hand tobacco smoke, notwithstanding whether it leads to depression and so on, because we know that second-hand tobacco smoke also increases the risk of cancer.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Regarding second-hand tobacco smoke in homes, I think I have reiterated my answers many times.
